summary: Activities sync and list read GET /activities by page number; deals sync sends no created_after lower bound and pages in full every run.
reason: GET /activities returns PaginationMeta (page, per_page, total, has_more) with no next cursor, so the generated cursor setting stopped sync after page one with cursor_unavailable. Deals expose only created_after/created_before, no last-changed filter, so an incremental created_after sync never re-read a deal whose stage or value changed (Greptile PR #2450 round 3, both P1).
validated_outcome: TestNovel1219ActivitiesSyncAndListPageByNumber and TestNovel1219DealsSyncHasNoCreatedAfterLowerBound; the FULL live gate covers activities list and sync.
